items.question: What is the primary function of an Activation Function in an ANN?
items.answer: An activation function introduces non-linearity to ANN inputs, enabling the network to learn complex relationships.

items.question: How does Batch Normalization stabilize ANN training?
items.answer: Batch normalization normalizes input data for each layer, reducing internal covariate shift and enhancing stability during training.

items.question: What are some common applications of Deep Learning models?
items.answer: Common applications include image recognition, natural language processing, speech recognition, and predictive modeling.

items.question: Why do we use CNNs for image recognition tasks?
items.answer: Convolutional neural networks excel at image recognition due to their ability to extract features from spatial hierarchies using convolutional and pooling layers.

items.question: What is the difference between Self-Attention and Attention mechanisms in NLP?
items.answer: Self-attention focuses on relationships within a sequence, while attention mechanisms in NLP focus on relevance between input elements and contextualized representations.
